preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit the floating pragma vulnerability

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, exploit the floating pragma by setting the tax fee to 100% using setTaxFeePercent(). This will cause all transfers to be taxed at 100%, effectively freezing token transfers and breaking contract functionality. The floating pragma allows potential compiler version mismatches that could lead to unexpected behavior when interacting with the contract.
